Description.description: Manual N:N intersect between sprk_practicearea_ref and sprk_documenttype_ref (per Insights Engine r2 design-a3 §2). Carries per-pair Layer 2 routing columns (layer2actioncode, layer2required, gatesignal) that auto-generated N:N intersect cannot. NULL sprk_layer2actioncode = structured gate-fail (Phase 1.5 replacement for outcomeBearing=false).
